new_source_declaration.purpose: Independent confirmation only after development method is frozen; no model scores used for source choice
new_source_declaration.selection_basis: public real measurements, chronological length, clear CC BY4.0, energy and mobility domains; no performance-based replacement

AppliancesEnergy.rule: entire series, preserve source dates, all selected columns must be finite; no target imputation, no score-based trimming

SeoulBike.rule: entire series including nonfunctional hours; preserve Date+Hour; numeric selected columns only, exclude Hour/categorical metadata from sensor set, no score-based trimming

new_source_declaration.source_usage: Neither new dataset is read, fitted or scored until policy development and method choice are frozen
new_source_declaration.gate: unchanged original gate; all two-data x three original arrival conditions x three seeds, paired block42 and sensitivity6, improvement>=1%, lower95>0, each seed positive, MAE regression<=1% versus both strong simple and legacy joint
new_source_declaration.scope: replicated effects on this predeclared suite only; simulated arrival/cost proxies, not every environment or real operating savings

added_comparators: target-availability conditional waiting, on original and Gaussian forecasters

MSFT.original_provider: Kaggle price-volume-data-for-all-us-stocks-etfs, cited by pmdarima loader
MSFT.selection: availability, length and different domains selected before any model score was inspected
MSFT.time_axis: one computational day = one trading observation; weekends/holidays are not elapsed latency
MSFT.unit: historical close quote as supplied, not verified execution prices or investment returns

Taylor.selection: availability, length and different domains selected before any model score was inspected
Taylor.time_axis: half-hour order; computational 2000-01-01 epoch is artificial, not a claimed original clock alignment

protocol.evaluation_contract: All new data and all three seeds required; prior failures are retained; no automatic deployment

excluded_candidates.short_locally_bundled_series: insufficient temporal partition length; no performance inspected

protocol.freezing_scope: Local code/protocol commit before any new-series model score; not remotely preregistered
protocol.independent_scope: Two unexposed datasets separately trained; artificial observation order, simulated arrivals and costs; not universal or operational superiority
rules: Keep the original 55/20/10/15 chronological partitions, lookback48,horizon6,stride4.
VAR training uses only transitions fully known by train cutoff; fit arrival survival on a mature training cohort.
Calibrate Gaussian absolute-risk scale using policy labels arrived by policy cutoff; choose only on validation.
ETTh1 is already exposed development data. Never call this an independent confirmation.
All costs, deadlines and original minimum-improvement gates remain unchanged.
Freeze code/config before each complete evaluation. Preserve unsuccessful forced candidate and selected fallback.
Independent new-data evaluation is required before promotion; a passing development gate does not promote.
No outcome-based dataset selection or period trimming.
MSFT uses ordered trading observations, not physical calendar-day delays; preserve real-date mapping.
Taylor uses an explicit artificial epoch for half-hour sequence order.
Cost weights and all numerical gate conditions remain unchanged.
Availability-aware simple strategies are added rather than weakening comparators.
Policy-only uses a Gaussian covariance proxy with a different forecaster; exact Bayes-risk claims do not apply.
Level calibration uses policy partition, selection uses validation only, final results never select candidates.
Taylor and MSFT final tests are exposed and never scored for this selection.
Use entire BikeSharing hourly series and all complete selected-measurement BeijingPM25 rows; no outcome-based trimming.
Preserve original date mapping; horizon is six retained observations, not necessarily physical hours.
Do not weaken original strong simple, objective, three arrival conditions, seeds or gate.
Freeze code/source/settings before any new-dataset model fitting.
Repeat independent training and policy fitting with identical pinned dependencies.
Development v1 exposed validation only; add masked per-plan hist regressions before independent fitting. Preserve rejected v1 and full candidate pool.
protocol.selection: VAR: minimum validation passive MAE across three decision times; policy: validation objective subject to 1% MAE limit; strong simple always admitted
protocol.simple_pool: base/upgraded/value plus all VAR candidates; each instant/half/deadline x none/target/oldest

plan_learning.augmentation: one random acquired subset per policy origin and wait plus empty subset
plan_learning.label: current abs error minus terminal abs error minus new realized pull cost minus incremental delay; labels offline only
plan_learning.selection: global regressor candidate selected on mean relative validation improvement across Taylor/MSFT seed42; per-dataset margin and fallback selected on validation only subject to 1% MAE limit; independent test never selects

selection_rule: One globally selected settings dictionary using mean development gain across four exposed datasets with MAE-safe fallback; per-new-data validation selects strength/margin by mean gain across fixed three development arrival views subject to every-view MAE regression<=1%; fallback if no positive mean gain. Final tests never select.
scope: Effects across the predeclared suite only; simulated arrivals and relative sensor/delay costs; no universal superiority claim.

legacy_bundle_export_evaluation.permitted: The unchanged base run_experiment automatically computes and exports legacy forecast/policy test/outage metrics before the per-case router selection. Global method is already frozen before any new-source fitting.
legacy_bundle_export_evaluation.prohibited: Those test metrics may not be inspected or used to select reference forecasters, routers, hyperparameters, arrival conditions, sources or periods. All router selection uses only declared policy/validation arrays.
legacy_bundle_export_evaluation.candidate_boundary: Per-case router, calibration strength and margin are sealed before any candidate final test scores are computed. This is not a claim that legacy export never computed test metrics.

calibration_scope: Router fitting and later distinct-origin router calibration are chronologically separated by54 observations. The forecast ridge calibrator is fitted on the train partition, not policy. Router uncertainty penalties remain heuristic and have no guaranteed coverage.
